rationale: All 19 executed controls pass (reference, empty, missing-file, recomputed-oracle and independent-alternative baselines; plus 14 probes, every wrong_solution failing its intended check and every valid_alternative passing), so the acceptance precondition holds with no unresolved issue. The candidate package was verified end-to-end: scope is confined to the single approved output (the marker-gene table conditional on the supplied grouping; excluded notebook branches are not solver requirements); inputs carry identity/grouping only with no DE content; the reference projection passes recorded scanpy values through verbatim with rank from the derive-side-verified descending order; oracle and independent implementation reproduce the population (17,041 cells; tested universe 23,427 genes equals reference rows/17; T = 5853.0 in both) and both pass the grader, so tolerances are not tuned to one implementation. Every public addendum rule was traced to a named check in the grader code (strict header and field parsing rejecting BOM/blank/ragged rows; key coverage with duplicate/missing/extra detection; ascending-numeric-cluster-then-rank ordering with ranks exactly 1..G; finite/[0,1] numeric validation; per-(cluster,gene) comparisons of 2e-4 absolute score, 1e-4 absolute log2fc, 1e-2 relative p with the asymmetric 1e-303 underflow zone; and tolerance-banded rank consistency against both own and reference scores); all guarded paths fail closed with exit 0 and exactly one result per declared id, and the previously rejected duplicate-check-emission defect is verified fixed. Tolerances are defensible against recorded measurements (faithful deviations ~1.0e-4 score vs 2e-4 tolerance, 1.9e-6 log2fc vs 1e-4, <=2.2e-3 relative p vs 1e-2, underflow zone necessary because the reference stores exact zeros where stable evaluation remains subnormal), and each wrong-method family fails by orders of magnitude in the executed probes, so no tolerance accommodates a wrong scientific method; boundary behavior is pinned from both sides (uniform +2.5e-4 score shift fails for all 23,427 pairs of a cluster while +5e-5 passes; sub-1e-303 zeros accepted while 1.58e-303-vs-0 and 2-threshold rounded-away values fail). No leakage or hardcoding: reference labels, gene sets and per-cluster counts are read dynamically; the grader is stdlib-only, reads no task inputs, and never executes submission code. Two probe-quality observations were downgraded from issues after verification (note for regeneration only, no effect on this candidate): the 'floored tail' sub-defect in wrong-pvalue-tail-variants is inert code in a file that still fails pvalue_agreement via its genuine one-sided-tail defect (50,626 rows, factor-2 relative-tail rejection executed), and the out-of-range 1.5 rows in wrong-significant-digits-range block the numeric comparison over that probe's 6,000 coarsely rounded rows and 5 rounded-away p-values, but every detection surface has executed positive evidence elsewhere in the suite (wrong-score-tolerance-band for absolute boundaries, the one-sided tail for relative comparison, wrong-underflow-boundary with 13 rejected rows and wrong-rank1-marker-transposition with 4 rejected cells for zero-replacing-nonzero, and 2-sig-digit deviations exceed the executed boundaries by two-plus orders of magnitude); neither flaw creates a false acceptance, a false rejection, or a crash. Session-only controls without attached reports are treated as claims, not evidence; packaging should rely on the 19 attached controls. Disclosed residuals match the candidate's own honest limitations (sub-2e-4 z errors undetectable; population/gene-universe reproduction enforced via key coverage rather than re-derivation; portability claimed only for the executed implementations).
